dedupe_keys.name: design optimisation benchmark networks from the university of adelaide jilin rural fosspoly1 zj balerma and kl

description: Six water distribution design benchmarks from the literature were contributed by Graeme Dandy of the University of Adelaide as entries 39, 40 and 42 to 45 of the Water Distribution System Research Database: the Jilin network (Bi and Dandy 2014), the Rural network (Marchi et al. 2012), Fosspoly1 (Bragalli et al. 2012), the ZJ network (Zheng et al. 2011), Balerma (Reca and Martinez 2006) and the KL network (Kang and Lansey 2012). Each entry offers an EPANET zip, most also a description PDF, and DataCite holds DOIs under the titles Jilin, Marchi Rural System, Italy1, China Model, Spain1 and KL Network. The summary spreadsheet gives the sizes: Jilin 34 pipes, Rural 476, Fosspoly1 58, ZJ 164, Balerma 454 and KL 1,274; all are looped, with one to four reservoirs and no pumps or tanks. They are design cases with no calibration; the networks come from China, Italy and Spain, so the coverage is international, not one region. The files are free; the pages state no licence, only a copyright notice. Only the index page, the entry pages, the summary spreadsheet and DataCite metadata were read; no network file was downloaded or run. Typical uses are pipe-sizing and cost optimisation, evolutionary and multiobjective algorithm comparison, and scaling tests from tiny to large networks. Related records: the New York Tunnels and Hanoi benchmark records, EPANET and the database record.
